Adaptive DMG is determined by the highest of your current Damage Type Stats (PDMG Bonus%, MDMG Bonus%), Damage Range Type Stats (Melee PDMG%, Ranged PDMG%, Ranged MDMG%), and Element Type Stats (Neutral DMG%, Water DMG%, Earth DMG%, Fire DMG%, Wind DMG%, Poison DMG%, Holy DMG%, Shadow DMG%, Ghost DMG%, Undead DMG%). Damage type and bonus calculation are based on the highest Stat. Damage dealt ignores Element Advantage and Weapon Size Advantage, remaining at 100%.
